source_text: The European Parliament has addressed circumcision peripherally in reports on religious freedoms, noting its prevalence for non-medical reasons in several member states without recommending bans, while Catholic Church bodies like COMECE have warned in 2018 that criminalization could undermine broader fundamental rights protections.
